food.title: Mumbai, Delhi and Jaipur Ranked Among World's Best Street Food Cities
food.excerpt: Top chefs endorse global rankings as Mumbai's khau gallis and Delhi's Mughlai lanes earn international recognition from Time Out and TasteAtlas.
food.nri_angle: Street food serves as a visceral connection to home for the diaspora; international validation may spur more Indian street food concepts abroad.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Maharashtra Bans Analogue Paneer for One Year, Violators Face Jail Time
food.excerpt: The state escalates from mandatory disclosure to an outright prohibition on fake paneer in all hotels and restaurants, with penalties including six months imprisonment.
food.nri_angle: NRI visitors and the diaspora frequently consume paneer dishes when traveling to India; the ban ensures they receive genuine dairy products at restaurants.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Biryani King Brings Punjabi Soul Food to Honolulu's Sheridan Street
food.excerpt: A Pakistani-born chef's home-style cooking — from charcoal tandoor naan to oxtail biryani — is winning over Hawaiʻi's food scene and its desi community.
food.image_caption: Biryani King, a new Punjabi restaurant on Honolulu's Sheridan Street, specialises in home-style biryani and North Indian cuisine
food.nri_angle: A Pakistani Punjabi immigrant chef brings home-style cooking to Honolulu, filling a gap for the city's South Asian community
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Bengaluru's Legendary MTR Is Opening in Sydney, Bringing Its Century-Old Dosas to Australia
food.excerpt: Australia's assistant minister for multicultural affairs confirmed the 102-year-old Mavalli Tiffin Rooms will franchise in Sydney, adding to a growing list of international outposts.
food.image_caption: MTR (Mavalli Tiffin Rooms), credited with inventing the rava idli, is opening a franchise in Sydney
food.nri_angle: MTR's expansion to Sydney is a landmark moment for the large Indian-Australian community, many of whom have roots in South India and nostalgia for the restaurant's iconic dishes.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Hyderabad Police Seize 25,000 Kg of Adulterated Spices Laced With Industrial Dyes
food.excerpt: Raids on 13 spice processing units uncover fabric dye, synthetic colours, and talcum powder being used to make low-quality spices appear premium, part of a 140-day crackdown that has seized 246 tonnes of suspect food products.
food.image_caption: Hyderabad police seized 25,000 kilograms of adulterated spices laced with industrial dyes in a crackdown on food safety violations.
food.nri_angle: Indian spices are widely exported and sold globally. Adulteration in the supply chain raises questions about quality reaching diaspora consumers from London to Toronto to Sydney.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: India's Food Regulator Bars Dabur From Selling Products With Misleading '100%' Claims
food.excerpt: FSSAI issues a prohibition order against Dabur India for labeling products as '100% Natural' and '100% Pure' without valid regulatory backing.
food.nri_angle: Many NRIs regularly purchase Dabur products abroad, from honey to ghee. This ruling may force label changes on products sold in Indian grocery stores worldwide.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: FSSAI Bans Select Variants of Old Monk, Royal Challenge, and Bagpiper Over Artificial Flavouring
food.excerpt: India’s food safety regulator ordered six whisky and rum brands off shelves after finding they violated rules on artificial flavouring in alcoholic beverages.
food.image_caption: Old Monk rum is among the brands affected by FSSAI's ban on select variants containing artificial flavouring agents.
food.nri_angle: Old Monk is an iconic brand among Indian diaspora communities worldwide; the ban raises questions about variants sold internationally.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Beyond the Rasgulla War: How Sun-Dried Mango Powers Odisha's Overlooked Cuisine
food.excerpt: Ambula — salted, sun-dried mango — quietly anchors Odia cooking, lending a sour depth to curries, chutneys, and rice dishes that most Indian food lovers have never encountered.
food.image_caption: Sun-dried mango, or ambula, is a staple of Odia cuisine used in curries, dals, and chutneys across Odisha.
food.nri_angle: Introduces diaspora readers to a largely unknown regional Indian cuisine and a home-preservation technique — sun-drying mango — that is accessible even abroad.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Six Indian Cities Crack TasteAtlas Global Top 100, Mumbai Leads at Number Five
food.excerpt: Mumbai's street food culture propelled it into the top five of TasteAtlas's 2025-26 ranking of the world's best food cities, while Amritsar, New Delhi, Hyderabad, Kolkata, and Chennai also earned spots on the 100-city list.
food.nri_angle: The TasteAtlas ranking validates the culinary traditions diaspora communities carry with them, from Mumbai's vada pav to Chennai's filter coffee.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Glasgow's Mister Singh's Hosted Team India, Then a Map on Its Napkins Sparked Outrage
food.excerpt: Olympic medallist Lovlina Borgohain called out the iconic Punjabi restaurant after its printed napkins displayed an India map missing the entire Northeast region.
food.nri_angle: The controversy highlights how diaspora-run restaurants abroad represent India's identity — and the emotional weight of accurate territorial depiction for overseas communities.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: A Japanese Chef Spent 15 Years Perfecting Biryani. Tokyo's Michelin Guide Noticed.
food.excerpt: Chef Takamasa Osawa's 10-seat biryani restaurant in Tokyo earned a Bib Gourmand in the Michelin Guide Tokyo 2026, making it only the second biryani-focused establishment globally to receive Michelin recognition.
food.nri_angle: The Michelin recognition of a biryani restaurant in Tokyo highlights both the global spread of Indian cuisine and the absence of Michelin coverage from India's own culinary heartlands.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Jetstar to Charge Passengers for Overhead Locker Access Starting February 2027
travel.excerpt: Qantas's budget subsidiary will require travelers to purchase a Priority Carry-on add-on to stow bags in overhead bins, joining a global shift toward unbundled airfares.
travel.nri_angle: Jetstar operates key routes between Australia and Southeast Asia used heavily by the Indian diaspora, and the carry-on fee will affect budget-conscious travelers on these corridors.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Ranthambore Safari Bookings Crash as Record Demand Overwhelms New Portal
travel.excerpt: Rajasthan's revamped booking website for India's most popular tiger reserve buckled under massive traffic as the October–December season opened, highlighting surging wildlife tourism demand.
travel.nri_angle: NRIs and international tourists planning India wildlife trips face the same booking gridlock, with the new portal requiring passport uploads and foreign cards often failing on Indian payment gateways.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Oman Launches Free 14-Day Tourist Visa for 103 Countries — Here's What Indian Travelers Need to Know
travel.excerpt: The sultanate's amended residence regulations open visa-free entry for over a hundred nationalities, but Indian passport holders must meet specific conditions to qualify for the two-week stay.
travel.nri_angle: For the 7.4 million Indians living in GCC countries, Oman's visa-free entry removes a key barrier for weekend getaways, while Indians with US/UK/Schengen visas gain hassle-free access.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Canada Issues 3,000 Invitations in Latest Canadian Experience Class Express Entry Draw
carousel.excerpt: IRCC held its 13th CEC draw of 2026 on August 5, maintaining a CRS cutoff of 516 as total invitations for the year surpass 108,000.
carousel.nri_angle: Indians consistently rank as the largest source country for Canadian permanent residence applications, and CEC draws disproportionately benefit Indian temporary workers and international students already in Canada.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: From Gas to Stone: How Scientists Are Turning Carbon Dioxide Into Rock
carousel.excerpt: Researchers in Iceland, MIT, and South Korea are advancing carbon mineralization technologies that convert CO2 into solid minerals, offering permanent climate storage solutions.
carousel.nri_angle: Indian researchers at institutions including IIT and TERI are studying basalt formations in the Deccan Traps — one of the world's largest volcanic rock formations — as potential carbon storage sites.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: PVR INOX Bets on ₹175 Tickets to Crack India's Small-Town Cinema Market
carousel.excerpt: The multiplex giant's new 'Smart Cinema' format halves construction costs and slashes ticket prices, targeting 300 cities where no quality theatre exists.
carousel.nri_angle: PVR INOX's Smart Cinema pivot mirrors the broader trend of Indian consumer businesses finding scalable models for tier-2 and tier-3 markets, a key growth theme for NRI investors.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: How India Usurped Cricket's Throne From England and Australia
carousel.excerpt: From IPL billions to global franchise ownership, India's financial and competitive dominance has reshaped the sport—though the latest Test rankings show the on-field race remains tight.
carousel.nri_angle: India's cricket dominance is a source of pride and identity for the diaspora, with the IPL's expanding global reach making the sport more accessible to NRI communities worldwide.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: NASA's Roman Space Telescope Targets August 30 Launch, Will Double as Asteroid Hunter
carousel.excerpt: The most powerful survey telescope ever built enters final prelaunch work at Kennedy Space Center, nine months ahead of schedule, with capabilities spanning dark energy research to planetary defense.
carousel.nri_angle: The Roman Space Telescope builds on contributions from Indian-American scientists and engineers at NASA, JPL, and partner institutions who have played key roles in its development.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Banks Near $15 Billion Loan for Anthropic Data Center Backed by Google Guarantees
carousel.excerpt: Morgan Stanley leads a bank consortium financing a massive Texas AI campus, with Google backstopping the deal in exchange for a 20% equity stake.
carousel.nri_angle: Indian-American engineers hold senior positions at both Anthropic and Google's AI hardware division, and the deal will accelerate demand for AI talent in the U.S.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk
